description: AgroVision AI 2.0 Decision Status Catalog establishing explicit selective prediction, abstention, and referral states.

statuses.description: Image candidate scores, verified crop selection, plant organ, and farmer symptoms align without critical contradictions.
trigger_conditions: Farmer selected crop matches candidate disease host in canonical registry
Plant organ is PERMITTED or REFERENCE_ONLY_UNTESTED in compatibility matrix
At least one reported symptom matches disease pathology profile
No critical contradictory symptoms (e.g. Healthy vs Severe Rot)
Top candidate score exceeds ambiguity margin
statuses.farmer_action: Review diagnostic findings, confirm visual symptom match, and follow validated integrated pest management (IPM) guidelines.

statuses.description: Two or more candidate diseases have comparable visual and symptom evidence. Diagnostic engine refuses to declare a single forced winner.
trigger_conditions: Margin between top-1 and top-2 candidate evidence scores is below provisional ambiguity threshold (margin < 0.15)
Both candidates share similar foliar symptoms or look-alike lesion morphology
Crop matches both candidates
statuses.farmer_action: Review the differential candidate comparison and answer the provided targeted follow-up question to distinguish between them.

statuses.description: Crucial diagnostic context is missing or uncertain, preventing reliable conclusion.
trigger_conditions: Symptom answers marked 'unsure' or essential progression details omitted
Image candidate score is moderate and symptom overlap is high
Targeted follow-up question is available in Phase 4 questionnaire configuration
statuses.farmer_action: Answer the recommended follow-up questions regarding lesion color, pattern, or moisture conditions to refine the assessment.

statuses.description: Disagreement between farmer-selected crop and visual model feature evidence. The system preserves the disagreement and refuses silent overwrite.
trigger_conditions: Farmer explicitly selected Crop A, but visual image classifier predicted Crop B with high confidence
Model top candidate belongs to a botanical species different from farmer's selection
statuses.farmer_action: Confirm whether the photo shows the selected crop or re-upload a close-up image showing clear foliage and plant structure.

statuses.description: The affected plant organ is biologically incompatible with the candidate disease or unrepresented in training data.
trigger_conditions: Organ policy is UNSUPPORTED for the selected crop in crop_organ_compatibility_matrix.json
Candidate disease affects foliage only, but farmer reported root/tuber infection
statuses.farmer_action: Verify the affected plant part. If symptoms are on stems or roots, consult local agricultural extension officers as foliar models cannot evaluate root pathogens.

statuses.description: The selected crop is not part of the validated 15 canonical crop species in AgroVision AI 2.0.
trigger_conditions: Farmer selected 'crop_unsupported' or an uncataloged botanical species
statuses.farmer_action: Automated AI diagnosis is currently uncalibrated for this crop. Please take physical plant samples to your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or university extension clinic.

statuses.description: Neural network model checkpoint could not be executed due to system runtime or operating system DLL policy restrictions.
trigger_conditions: TensorFlow/TFLite C++ wrapper blocked by OS Application Control policy
Missing model checkpoint file on disk
Corrupted weights file
statuses.farmer_action: Vision inference is temporarily paused. The system provides rule-based symptom triage based on your questionnaire answers.

statuses.description: The submitted payload contains malformed parameters, corrupted image data, or invalid identifiers.
trigger_conditions: Invalid canonical crop ID not found in registry
Unknown symptom identifiers not in configuration
Image file unreadable or zero-byte
statuses.farmer_action: Please re-submit the questionnaire with valid inputs.

statuses.description: Neither visual features nor reported symptoms provide sufficient evidence to support any disease hypothesis.
trigger_conditions: Visual model scores are uniformly low (maximum score below baseline threshold)
No distinctive symptoms reported (only general uninformative signs)
High uncertainty across all evaluation dimensions
statuses.farmer_action: Capture a clearer, well-lit photo in natural daylight focusing on the boundary between healthy and diseased tissue.

statuses.description: Severe contradictions, suspected novel pathogen, or high-consequence symptom pattern warranting professional plant pathologist evaluation.
trigger_conditions: Severe contradiction between visual model and farmer symptoms (e.g. Model says Healthy, but farmer reports Rapid Field Wilting)
Suspected quarantine pathogen or unusual vector outbreak
statuses.farmer_action: Contact your local agricultural extension officer, state horticulture department, or KVK plant pathologist immediately with fresh plant specimens.
